leds.evidence: Three LEDs (red, yellow, green) are clearly visible in a vertical row on the breadboard.

found: Resistor 1 connected to the red LED row
Resistor 2 connected to the yellow LED row
Resistor 3 connected to the green LED row
resistor_count.evidence: Three resistors are visible, each connected in series with one of the three LEDs.

led_polarity.evidence: The resolution is not high enough to clearly distinguish the flat side or the leg lengths of the LEDs to determine polarity.

button.evidence: A round blue push button is visible on the breadboard.

button_across.evidence: The button is placed across the central gap of the breadboard, with two pins on one side and two on the other.

buzzer.evidence: A black round buzzer is visible on the breadboard below the button.

gnd_other_end.evidence: The black wire from the GND pin on the Arduino connects to the negative power rail on the breadboard.
